rows.text: Before you stand two doors — one ancient and solemn, cast in bronze. The other radiant and opulent, sculpted from gold. You've been staring at them, unmoving, for an entire day — ever since you wandered too deep into this twisting labyrinth.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: As an adventurer who has roamed the farthest reaches of the world, you've seen the Janus priests use their mystical "passages" to bypass insurmountable barriers. But once a gate is opened, there's no going back.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Luckily, you aren't limited to a simple A or B choice. There's always a third option — walking out on your own.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "This has to be one of Janus' tricks!" you mutter before disappearing into the labyrinth's shadows.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
